test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A total of 50 students are in a row. Ankit is at the 19th position from the start of the row. What is the position of Ankit from the end of the row?
solution:
Given: 50 students.

Position of Ankit from the start of the row = 19th

So, the position of Ankit from the end of the row = Total Students - Position of Ankit from the start of the row + 1

= 50 - 19 + 1 = 32.

So, position of Ankit from the end of the row is 32ⁿd.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
